segments.ja444:1.1: Sattāhamevāhaṃ pasannacitto, puññatthiko ācariṃ [acariṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] brahmacariyaṃ;
segments.ja444:1.3: Athāparaṃ yaṃ caritaṃ mamedaṃ [mama yidaṃ (syā.), mamāyidaṃ (pī.)], vassāni paññāsa samādhikāni;
segments.ja444:1.5: Akāmako vāpi [vāhi (pī. ka.)] ahaṃ carāmi, etena saccena suvatthi hotu;
segments.ja444:2.1: Yasmā dānaṃ nābhinandiṃ kadāci, disvānahaṃ atithiṃ vāsakāle;
segments.ja444:2.3: Na cāpi me appiyataṃ aveduṃ, bahussutā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca.
segments.ja444:2.5: Akāmako vāpi ahaṃ dadāmi, etena saccena suvatthi hotu;
segments.ja444:3.1: Āsīviso tāta pahūtatejo, yo taṃ adaṃsī [aḍaṃsī (syā.)] sacarā [bilarā (sī.), piḷārā (syā.), patarā (pī.)] udicca;
segments.ja444:3.3: Tasmiñca me appiyatāya ajja, pitari ca te natthi koci viseso;
segments.ja444:3.5: Etena saccena suvatthi hotu, hataṃ visaṃ jīvatu yaññadatto.
segments.ja444:4.1: Santā dantāyeva [dantā santā ye ca (syā. ka.)] paribbajanti, aññatra kaṇhā natthākāmarūpā [anakāmarūpā (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja444:4.3: Dīpāyana kissa jigucchamāno, akāmako carasi brahmacariyaṃ.
segments.ja444:5.1: Saddhāya nikkhamma punaṃ nivatto, so eḷamūgova bālo [eḷamūgo capalo (syā. ka.)] vatāyaṃ;
segments.ja444:5.3: Etassa vādassa jigucchamāno, akāmako carāmi brahmacariyaṃ;
segments.ja444:5.5: Viññuppasatthañca satañca ṭhānaṃ [viññūpasatthaṃ vasitaṃ ca ṭhānaṃ (ka.)], evampahaṃ puññakaro bhavāmi.
segments.ja444:6.1: Samaṇe tuvaṃ brāhmaṇe addhike ca, santappayāsi annapānena bhikkhaṃ;
segments.ja444:6.3: Opānabhūtaṃva gharaṃ tava yidaṃ, annena pānena upetarūpaṃ;
segments.ja444:6.5: Atha kissa vādassa jigucchamāno, akāmako dānamimaṃ dadāsi.
segments.ja444:7.1: Pitaro ca me āsuṃ pitāmahā ca, saddhā ahuṃ dānapatī vadaññū;
segments.ja444:7.3: Taṃ kullavattaṃ anuvattamāno, māhaṃ kule antimagandhano [gandhino (syā. pī. ka.), gandhinī (sī.)] ahuṃ;
segments.ja444:7.5: Etassa vādassa jigucchamāno, akāmako dānamimaṃ dadāmi.
segments.ja444:8.1: Dahariṃ kumāriṃ asamatthapaññaṃ, yaṃ tānayiṃ ñātikulā sugatte;
segments.ja444:8.3: Na cāpi me appiyataṃ avedi, aññatra kāmā paricārayantā [paricārayantī (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja444:8.5: Atha kena vaṇṇena mayā te bhoti, saṃvāsadhammo ahu evarūpo.
segments.ja444:9.1: Ārā dūre nayidha kadāci atthi, paramparā nāma kule imasmiṃ;
segments.ja444:9.3: Taṃ kullavattaṃ anuvattamānā, māhaṃ kule antimagandhinī ahuṃ;
segments.ja444:9.5: Etassa vādassa jigucchamānā, akāmikā paddhacarāmhi [paṭṭhacarāmhi (syā. ka.)] tuyhaṃ.
segments.ja444:10.1: Maṇḍabya bhāsiṃ yamabhāsaneyyaṃ [bhāsissaṃ abhāsaneyyaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), bhāsissa’ mabhāsaneyyaṃ (?)], taṃ khamyataṃ puttakahetu majja;
segments.ja444:10.3: Puttapemā na idha paratthi kiñci, so no ayaṃ jīvati yaññadattoti.
